name: Dafang Construction
description:
Dafang Construction introduces a new perspective on building materials. Unlike the standard 'grid mindset,' we utilize the Pattern rendering mode from the Fusion Mod to enable large-scale, elongated brick effects that shatter the 1x1 block boundary.

Featuring photorealistic 32x32 textures inspired by modern public architecture, these blocks are obtained via crafting and can be processed through a Stonecutter for varied textures and sizes. Standard slabs, stairs, and walls are also included. 

Note: Fusion Mod MUST be installed on the client for correct rendering. 

Design Philosophy: No connected textures, no complex setups. Just pick a block and build boldly. Out-of-the-box utility is our core philosophy.
